name: swiftui-app-design
description: Build SwiftUI screens and flows that feel like a real iPhone app: native navigation, lists, forms and sheets, Dynamic Type, dark mode and accessibility, onboarding, paywalls and settings planned from how real apps do them, and checked in previews on small and large iPhones. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for 300+ real iOS apps and their full user journeys.

interface.longDescription: Build SwiftUI screens and flows that feel like a real iPhone app: native navigation, lists, forms and sheets, Dynamic Type, dark mode and accessibility, onboarding, paywalls and settings planned from how real apps do them, and checked in previews on small and large iPhones. The skills work on their own. Optional: the UXKIN MCP server for 300+ real iOS apps and their full user journeys.

positive.description: Design question that should use the plugin and UXKIN: Find real onboarding flows for a meditation app and build one in SwiftUI.
positive.prompt: Find real onboarding flows for a meditation app and build one in SwiftUI.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows real onboarding journeys from iOS apps, then builds a SwiftUI onboarding flow based on them.
